title: 屋外ガスメーターまわり
description: 住宅の外壁に取り付ける、都市ガスのメーターと配管一式です。繊維セメントの取付板、灰色のメーター本体と目盛り窓、無地の銘板、ユニオンナット、黄色い入口・出口の配管と元栓レバー、配管押さえを造形しています。目盛りの数字・検定表示などの文字、壁の内部、実際のガス設備としての適合性は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.600 × 1.200 × 0.225 m、1,736三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wall-mounted residential gas meter with its piping. It models the fibre-cement backing board, grey meter casing with dial window and blank plate, union nuts, yellow inlet and outlet pipes with a shutoff valve lever, and pipe saddle clips. Dial numerals, certification markings and other lettering, the wall interior and suitability as real gas equipment are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.600 × 1.200 × 0.225 m; 1,736 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
